feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: How non-player characters in 'Grand Theft Auto VI' help create its big world
entry.summary: In video games, "barks" are short lines of dialogue given to various characters in the world. Grand Theft Auto VI proves how this kind of dialogue contributes to an immersive world.

entry.title: How the Steadicam sprinted up the stairs along with Rocky
entry.summary: A new movie about the making of Sylvester Stallone's 1976 film Rocky opens nationwide this week. It made him a star and helped revolutionize cinematography — including technology still used today.

entry.title: Armand Hammer has what it takes to outlast the end times
entry.summary: Their new album makes the case for rappers Elucid and billy woods as an era-defining team: attuned to a dark sociopolitical moment, yet powered by a humans-first creative ethic.

entry.title: Judges have put Trump's arch and golf course on hold, but only for a matter of days
entry.summary: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

entry.title: The 'Magic Six': How to strengthen your marriage in midlife
entry.summary: How do we maintain healthy romantic relationships as we age? Allison Aubrey and Scott Detrow talk about about the science of healthy, later-in-life relationships.

entry.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
entry.summary: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

entry.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
entry.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

entry.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
entry.summary: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

entry.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
entry.summary: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

entry.title: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
entry.summary: Rep. Gregory Meeks raises concerns about U.S. alliances after Trump's summit with Xi and Putin. He also discusses Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.
